name: obsidian-librarian
description: Maintains and organizes the Obsidian vault using PARA and Linked Documentation standards. Guidelines: 1. Use PARA (00_Inbox, 10_Projects, 20_Areas, 30_Resources, 40_Archive). 2. Exclude node_modules, .git, build, dist. 3. Prefer Project Nodes (MOCs) over loose scattered notes.

find_scattered_readmes.description: Scans for generic filenames (README.md) while ignoring build/dist/git folders. Returns absolute paths.

target_dir.description: The directory to scan. Defaults to user Documents.

index_scattered_note.description: Adds a permanent link to a scattered README into a Project Node or index file without moving the original file.

source_path.description: Absolute path to the scattered README.

target_node_path.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian project node or index file to receive the link.

audit_vault_structure.description: Ensures PARA folders exist and sweeps loose root notes to 00_Inbox (with rollback log).

vault_path.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault.

create_project_node.description: Scaffolds a new high-quality Project Node (MOC) with Dataview-ready frontmatter and technical headers.

vault_path.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault.

revert_librarian_action.description: Undoes the last batch of file moves performed by audit_vault_structure using the rollback log.

vault_path.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault.

consolidate_note.description: LEGACY: Use index_scattered_note for safety. Moves/renames a README into the vault.

set_property.description: Sets or updates a YAML frontmatter property on a specific note using the native Obsidian CLI. Ensures perfect YAML syntax.

file_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the file.

name.description: Name of the property to set (e.g., 'status').

value.description: Value to set the property to.

type.description: Type of the property (text, list, number, checkbox, date, datetime). Default is 'text'.

vault_path.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault.

auto_link_to_hub.description: Searches the vault for specific files and automatically prepends a Bi-directional link (e.g., Up: [[Hub]]) to all of them, restructuring the Obsidian Graph View.

search_query.description: The exact query to sweep the vault for (e.g., '#obsidian', 'Prometheus framework').

hub_file_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the central Hub or MOC file that should receive the incoming links.

vault_path.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault.
